amount_unit: integer USD cents; synthetic single currency
cdc_policy: Full after images; largest source_sequence wins per tenant and invoice; exact replay allowed; conflicting equal-sequence payloads rejected; apply deletes after selecting latest version.
history_policy: Customer segment as of invoice_date, valid_from inclusive and valid_to exclusive; date-only synthetic UTC business dates.
report_population: Current posted invoices only; exclude deleted invoices and draft invoices.
ratio_policy: Payment rate is sum(paid_cents) / sum(gross_cents) after all user filters; zero denominator yields null, including empty selections.
security_scope: Tenant query filters and tenant-key joins are functional isolation probes only, never warehouse access enforcement.
